name: shapeless
description: Drive a ShapelessAI account: jobs, posts, agents, Brand Memory - the hosted MCP server (sign in with OAuth, no key) plus a skill that knows the ropes.

interface.shortDescription: Post to LinkedIn, X and more
interface.longDescription: ShapelessAI drives your social accounts from ChatGPT. Connect LinkedIn, X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Threads or Bluesky once in ShapelessAI, then ask in plain words: research a topic, draft a post, render a carousel or clip, schedule it, publish it. Every publish needs your approval. Runs on your own ShapelessAI account.
defaultPrompt: ShapelessAI, connect my LinkedIn and write this week's posts in my voice.
ShapelessAI, turn my latest blog post into a LinkedIn post and an X thread.
ShapelessAI, what is trending in my niche today? Draft a post on it.
